_about: The socket table: where a blow lands and what lands it (render/anim/anim_fighter.gd, _contact_ik and _region_point). regions: the defender's body points a key set's "target" names (bone and offset in the bone's frame, model units; surface is how far the skin is in front of that point). limbs: the striking part a key set's "limb" names (hand_r, foot_l, elbow_r, knee_l, head; the suffix is the side). mode ik: a two-bone chain solved onto the target. mode aim: one bone turned so the tip (a joint, offset in its frame) points at it, for a blow that is a joint rather than an end (elbow, knee, head). end_len: the tip to the skin of the striking part. lunge_max / step_max: how far the hips, then the whole body, may carry the reach. reach_z: the lateral offset of the contact line (times the side). hunch_max: how far the clavicle hunch may bring the shoulder (data/anim/effectors.json). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
